title: One Workspace for the Whole Team
summary: A shared dashboard where a growing business tracks projects, clients, and daily tasks — all in one place.
disclosure: Selected sample — capability example, not a client engagement.
body: This sample explores a shared dashboard where a growing business can follow projects, clients, and daily tasks together, keeping everyday work visible in one place.
As a B2B Web Application example, it demonstrates project lists, client records, and daily task views arranged in a single workspace layout.
